output.sql:
SELECT ROUND(percentile_cont(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY o.net_revenue)::numeric, 2) AS median_net_order_value
FROM marts.fct_orders o
WHERE o.status = 'completed'
  AND o.order_date >= DATE '2025-01-01'
  AND o.order_date < DATE '2026-01-01';
output.explanation: The median is taken over net_revenue of orders with status 'completed' and order_date in calendar 2025, using percentile_cont(0.5) for a true median. Assumptions I could not verify: the status literal is exactly 'completed' (I had no tool to check distinct status values), and "net order value" maps to net_revenue. I did not add an is_revenue filter because the question specifies completed orders; if completed orders can include non-revenue rows, add AND o.is_revenue. I have not executed the query, so the result is unverified.
